verdict.rationale: Retell documents a first-party Press Digit tool that lets single- and multi-prompt agents send DTMF keypad digits to navigate IVR menus on outbound calls. That covers the DTMF and IVR half of the story. Nothing in the evidence pack documents voicemail detection or leaving a voicemail. Missing for 10: voicemail detection, leaving voicemail messages, depth on DTMF configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of IVR navigation.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can send DTMF keypresses, navigate IVR menus, and detect or leave voicemail

citations.quote: Enable Retell single or multi-prompt agents to navigate DTMF-input IVR menus by pressing keypad digits during outbound calls to reach the right department.
